resources.string: Stories, DMs and Profile Reels stay open. The feed and Explore Reels don\'t.

Watches Instagram\'s on-screen layout only to tell Stories, DM Reels and Profile Reels apart from the main Reels/Explore feed, and closes the Reels player when it was opened from the main feed or Explore. It does not read message content, photos, or anything outside Instagram.
Ongoing notification that keeps the Reels blocker running reliably in the background.
Blocking feed & Explore Reels. Stories, DMs and Profile Reels are unaffected.
✅ Protection is ON\nFeed & Explore Reels are blocked.
⚠️ Protection is OFF\nTurn on the ReelsBlocker accessibility service below.
Couldn\'t open that settings screen on this device.

ReelsBlocker only watches the Instagram app's screen layout through Android's Accessibility API — it never reads your messages, photos, or anything outside Instagram.

• Stories always play normally.
• Reels sent in a DM, or opened from someone's profile grid, play normally too.
• Opening the main Reels tab, or a Reel from the main feed or Explore, immediately backs out.
